title: Reflection symmetry of the Gaussian profile
statement: For every real number $a$, the closed Gaussian profile at $1-a$ equals its value at $a$.
replaced: Let $\Phi,\varphi$ be the standard Gaussian distribution function and density, and let $\overline I(p)=\varphi(\Phi^{-1}(p))$ for $0<p<1$, with $\overline I(p)=0$ elsewhere. For every real $a$, $\overline I(1-a)=\overline I(a)$.
